generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
In the Sanctioned Estimate, the item rates are showing inclusive of all applicable taxes but it is to be noted that rates are exclusive of taxes (GST).

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 continued to 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in the form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24 (As per the circular from Govt of Karnataka no.12/2024 Bengaluru dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, Amount put to Tender and ECV amounts are excluding GST even though it is showing inclusive Tax in Draft Tender Schedule Process. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. The bidder has to quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
The contractor shall submit the details of technical staff employed by him.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement (KPP) portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other applicable taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts, labor, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Further particulars, if any queries required to the Contractor, they can get from the office of the concerned Executive Engineer, PWD Division, during office hours on all working days.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.
The Tenderer should furnish all necessary original documents mentioned in the bid document to the Executive engineer at the time of verification of documents during Technical Bid evaluation
The intending bidders are requested to note that they should abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the bid documents and further orders there on.
Contractor has to upload the valid EPF registration copy.

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1 Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified on his own risk and cost.

Materials like bitumen, steel and cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the Quality Assurance Authority before commencement of the work.
Work shall be carried out according to relevant IS/IRC codes specifications depending on type of work.
The bidder has to establish field laboratory at the work site as per GO No:PWD/243/SEV/2013 Bengaluru dated:22.07.2014.
The Defect Liability period for this work is Two years.
Work sanctioned under the Head of Account 5054-80-190-0-01-132 KRDCL
The tenderer should be a KPWD registered Contractor Class III & Above Registration and the tenderer should submit registration certificate.

The contractor has to quote the same Rate to the same items of work to be executed at the same floor level. If in case, contractor quotes different rates for the same item appearing at different places of BOQ then, the lowest quoted rate for the same items will be considered for that particular item for evaluation and payment.

In SR 2023-24 Vol - 1 - Item Code : 1.7 Manual Means - Construction of Embankment with approved materials deposited at site from roadway cutting should be read as MECHANICAL MEANS - Construction of Embankment with approved materials deposited at site from roadway cutting
The Period of Completion is 9 months (Including monsoon).

Item No 4 5 and 6 should be read as Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) with Cement & Cementitious Materials. Providing and laying in position Ready Mixed or Batch Mixed concrete as per IS 10262 mix design procedure for Cement Concrete works in all types of Structures other than Road works, using coarse aggregate and fine aggregate derived from natural sources, Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) at 75 percentage and GGBS at 25 percentage proportion, admixtures to accelerate retard setting of concrete, to improve durability and workability without impairing strength including pumping of concrete to site of laying, curing, carriage for all leads but excluding reinforcement (including the cost of centering, shuttering) as per direction of the Engineer-in-charge.

In SR 2023-24 Vol - 1 - Item Code : 1.8 Manual Means - Construction of Embankment by excavating the available approved Gravel/ Murrum should be read as MECHANICAL MEANS - Construction of Embankment by excavating the available approved Gravel/ Murrum

itemList.description: Supplying  and  Fixing  of  Molded  Shank  Raised  Pavement Markers / Cats Eye made of polycarbonate and ABS moulded body and reflective panels with micro prismatic lens capable of providing total internal reflection of the light entering the lens face and shall support a load of 16000 kg tested in accordance to  ASTM  D  4280  Type  H  and  complying  to  Specifications  of Category   A   of   MORTH   Circular   No   RW/NH/33023/10-97 DO III Dt 11.06. 1997. The height, width and length shall not exceed 50 mm, 100 mm and 102 +/- 2 mm and with minimum reflective  area  of  13  cm2  on  each  side  and  the  slope  to  the base shall be 35 +/- 5 degree. The strength of detachment of the  integrated  cylindrical  shanks,  (of  diameter  not  less  than 19  +/-  2  mm  and  height  not  less  than  30+/-  2  mm)  from the  body  is  to  be  a  minimum  value  of  500  Kg.  Fixing  will  be by  drilling  holes  on  the  road  for  the  shanks  to  go  inside, without  nails  and  using  epoxy  resin  based  adhesive  as  per manufacturers recommendation and complete as directed by the engineer.The contractor shall submit a two year warranty for    satisfactory    field    performance    including    stipulated retro-reflectance   of   the   reflecting   panel,   to   the   Engineer. itemList.description: Providing Vertical Delineator having wide angle cube corner micro prismatic non metallic reflective sheeting confirming to Type XI of ASTM D4956 -09 with White Color and Red Color combination and having minimum of retro reflective exposed area of 125 Sq CM on top slots and 35 cm2 on bottom slots and no edges shall be exposed for tampering. This tubular delineator shall have a core and shell construction, shell shall be made of tough,  high  impact  resistant,  injection-molded,  thermoplastic outer body and the inner core shall consist of powder coated or painted Mild steel of minimum thickness 1.0mm.and core- shell structure shall be of height not less than 800 mm above the ground and width not less than 80 mm. The metallic core of the delineator shall extend 300mm beyond the shell length from bottom for installing in the ground. The extended portion shall  have  slots  to  insert  anchoring  rods  for  enhancing  the concrete grip. The logo of the manufacturer shall be embossed on  either  side  of  the  body  in  the  injection  molding  process. The engineering thermoplastic used for making the delineator body  shall  have  minimum  initial  mechanical  properties  of  be fixed by a combination of epoxy adhesive and grouting as per MoRTH specification 806.
